_about: For tools/build-carousel.py: per photo in the CIPS Image Library (its path as the picker shows it), the description shown to search engines and screen readers (alt), and optionally where to keep when cropping to 4:3 (focus: [x, y], 0 to 1, default the middle). A picked photo with no entry gets a plain description; add one here. Optionally "blur": a list of [x0, y0, x1, y1] areas (shares of the whole photo) to blur, such as a yacht's name. Optionally "trim": [left, top, right, bottom] shares to cut off first, such as a finger over the lens.
